profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Developer Platforms, Cloud Control Planes & API Gateways | C#/.NET, TypeScript/React, OAuth 2.0, Azure, MCP
profile.summary:
I build platform software that makes complex cloud systems easier for developers and operators to use.

Over 6+ years at Microsoft, I have worked across Azure API Management's portal, developer tooling, management APIs, and gateway runtime. I spent 4+ years on TypeScript and React product and developer-experience engineering, then expanded into C#/.NET backend and cloud control-plane work for API Management and AI Gateway.

Recent work includes building managed Model Context Protocol (MCP) resources and multi-backend routing; designing OAuth 2.0, PKCE, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, managed identity, and API-key flows; and connecting control-plane configuration to API gateway behavior.

I have also built Azure Portal workflows for provisioning, networking, Key Vault, APIs, schemas and GraphQL, workspaces, and diagnostics. I improve delivery through Playwright test infrastructure, Azure DevOps and OneBranch CI/CD, feature flags, staged releases, KQL, Grafana, telemetry, and alerting.

Beyond API Management, I contributed to a MicroVM-backed cloud application platform: C# activation, image-aware scheduling, auto-idle and scale-to-zero, snapshot-backed on-demand resume, and cluster-owned lifecycle state; Go/KVM PTP time synchronization; Python snapshot SDK operations; and TypeScript CLI authentication and self-update. In separate unmerged branch work, I prototyped Kubernetes/KEDA scheduling, reconciliation, and Helm deployment around a Go containerd CRI shim and NodeAgent gRPC service.

I am strongest where product engineering meets platform engineering: developer platforms, cloud control planes, API gateways, identity and access management, engineering productivity, and platform-shaped full-stack systems.

U.S. permanent resident; no sponsorship required.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Promoted from Software Engineer. Build cloud platform and product infrastructure for Azure API Management and AI Gateway.
- Build cloud control-plane and API gateway capabilities across C#/.NET, REST/OpenAPI, Entity Framework/SQL, gateway policy, and deployment configuration.
- Implemented managed Model Context Protocol (MCP) resources and multi-backend federation from control-plane projection through tool discovery and routed invocation.
- Designed OAuth 2.0/PKCE identity flows with Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, managed identity, API keys, and encrypted Redis state.
- Built Azure Portal developer workflows with TypeScript, React, Fluent UI, and Knockout for provisioning, networking, Key Vault, APIs, GraphQL, workspaces, and diagnostics.
- Built Playwright end-to-end infrastructure, fail-closed cleanup, and AI-assisted review workflows; improved Azure DevOps/OneBranch CI/CD, feature flags, and staged releases.
- Created KQL/Grafana telemetry and alerting for API health and portal reliability; used incident follow-up to drive durable fixes.
- Contributed to a MicroVM-backed cloud platform: implemented C# activation, image-aware scheduling, auto-idle/scale-to-zero, snapshot-backed resume, and cluster-owned lifecycle state; added Go/KVM PTP time sync, Python snapshot SDKs, and TypeScript CLI fixes. Separately prototyped an unmerged Kubernetes/KEDA and Helm path with reconciliation, a Go containerd CRI shim, and NodeAgent gRPC.

positions.title: Azure Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Built a schema-generation service that converted JSON examples into OpenAPI 2.0 definitions for Azure API Management.
- Developed Angular workflows for creating and managing API schemas from the Azure Portal and admin console.
- Added API-scoped schema management so users could browse definitions and update schema content without leaving the API workflow.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Created a pipeline to retrieve the data from the local database and publish it onto Feed pages.
- Provided sample C# and Javascript for Web API by throughoutly steping through business logic layers.
- Built and designed client tutorial pages implementing Open API Documentation.
- Technology used: ASP.NET, MVC, Bootstrap, Jquerry, Entity Framework, and Swagger.

honors.title: AMATYC Student Math League
honors.description:
First place on the AMATYC Math competition at Lone Star College.
Second place in the Southwest religion.

honors.title: Please. Don't Teach Me. Mr. Robot!
honors.description:
A short philosophy presentation discussed the potential advancement of Artificial Intelligence (AI), as well as provided a particular view on the probability that AI would directly affect human's labor in the future. Concentrated on the contradiction in Searle's argument "The Chinese Room" and Fred Dretske philosophy, the objection of the topic is to conclude the limit in the development of AI.

Selected to go to Twin Star Conference.

projects.title: GetTheClasses
projects.description:
- Programmed a web-service to analyzes and returns classes that fit students' schedule.
- Angular 6 combines with Angular material are used as the main tool for client-side development to provide best User Experience.
- Created server-side with NodeJS, with plenty of algorithms to help select the appropriate the combination of classes.
- Firebase with its powerful authentication services is used as the main database for this stage of development.
- Divided tasks into stories and organized them using Trello.

projects.title: ACESO
projects.description:
- A health service webpage that helped analyzing measured weight, blood pressure, and
body temperature.
- Kept track of all irregular data and sent all the information to the patient's doctor.
- Developed with Angular 5, Firebase, and Android Studio.
